epics.title: Falsification Findings Remediation
epics.jtbd: When the engineering team runs a self-falsification cycle, I want to resolve all confirmed findings, so that project compliance and methodological alignment are restored.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: decrease unresolved critical findings from 8 to 0
requirements: R1: Remove modifications to generated test-result files in 'target/surefire-reports/' from the PR #22 payload.
R2: Update the PR #20 task plan to replace the 'unknown' sixSigmaMetric baseline with a measurable starting baseline and target delta.
R3: Refactor the Flyway migration script in PR #19 to replace 'BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT' and 'TIMESTAMP' with 'gen_random_uuid()' and 'TIMESTAMPTZ'.
R4: Update the PR #18 task plan to specify a strict measurable starting baseline for its sixSigmaMetric.
R5: Implement '*Test.java' unit tests covering the new backend endpoints and service logic introduced in PR #21.
R6: Implement contract tests for the new backend endpoints introduced in PR #21.
R7: Remove the 'IF NOT EXISTS' clause from the PR #19 migration and resolve the actual root cause of the Flyway state mismatch.
R8: Realign the implementation and plans in PRs #18-22 to serve the epidemiological knowledge base domain, correcting the misinterpretation in PR #18.

slices.title: Falsification Patch and Test Implementation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification fixes for this epic, I want to patch the migrations, write the missing tests, and update the task plans, so that all confirmed findings are resolved in a single atomic change.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the PR #19 migration, When patched, Then it uses gen_random_uuid(), TIMESTAMPTZ, and omits IF NOT EXISTS while fixing the root cause.
Given the PR #21 endpoints, When updated, Then *Test.java unit and contract tests are provided.
Given the task plans in PR #18 and #20, When patched, Then their sixSigmaMetric fields have measurable baselines and deltas.
Given the PR #22 payload, When applied, Then target/surefire-reports/ is ignored and excluded.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce active falsification finding count from 8 to 0

slices.title: Falsification Patch Quality Assurance
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to execute the test suite and verify the migration fixes, so that the applied patches do not introduce regressions.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the patched DB migrations, When Flyway runs, Then the schema applies cleanly without 'IF NOT EXISTS' and state is synced.
Given the new tests for PR #21 endpoints, When `mvn test` is run, Then all unit and contract tests pass.
Given the repository files, When checked, Then no generated test reports are tracked in version control.
Given the updated task plans, When reviewed, Then the domain alignment matches the epidemiological knowledge base.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: increase test pass rate from baseline failing to 100% and reduce invariant violations from 8 to 0
